verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own configurable logic: ops can configure the customer risk-score equation and create multiple screening configurations, each with chosen screening lists, then pick one per customer. That is a thin, partial version of no-code verification logic. The docs do not show a visual or no-code builder, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: documented no-code/UI workflow builder, conditional step logic, explicit risk-based routing rules, country-specific requirement configuration, template changes without engineering deploy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy

citations.quote: You have the ability to configure the equation that calculates the risk score of your customers.
You can create multiple configurations and select the appropriate one for each customer during the screening process.
high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
